_meta.description: Pinned expected values for the Paper 2 (RB-GBMC) release. Checked by `python reproduce.py verify` against the checked-in summaries under output/final_prepublication_tests/. Directly computed quantities (E_bias/E_spread/E_total, stored arrays, spread slope) use strict/bit-identical checks; quantities from the nonlinear tanh curve_fit (fitted viscosity and derived summaries) use rtol 1e-8 to absorb optimizer-level variation across SciPy/BLAS builds. Values were pinned by reading the canonical files directly.
